dataset.title: Trade (% of GDP), 2022

indicator.name: Trade (% of GDP)
indicator.description: Sum of exports and imports of goods and services measured as a share of gross domestic product.

source.name: World Bank, World Development Indicators
source.citation: World Bank national accounts data, and OECD National Accounts data files (NE.TRD.GNFS.ZS).

notes: Imported from the hand-assembled file WBTradePercentOfGDP2022.json that was committed to this repo (originally hardcoded). Values are as of when that file was created; the World Bank revises data.
Entities listed with null in the source are kept as explicitly missing; World Bank regional/income aggregates are skipped.
caveats: Trade openness counts exports as well as imports, so entrepôt economies (Singapore, Hong Kong, Luxembourg) score very high without being proportionally dependent. Treat as exposure, not survival dependence.

scoring.rationale: Values exceed 100% for entrepôt economies and have no natural ceiling, so a rank-based score is the most transparent normalization.
